text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issue/PR Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run stale action
        uses: actions/stale@v4
        with:
          days-before-issue-stale: 90
          days-before-pr-stale: 90
          days-before-issue-close: 7
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-label: 'stale'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'important, pinned'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'important, pinned'
          close-issue-message: 'This issue has been automatically closed because it is stale.'
          close-pr-message: 'This pull request has been automatically closed because it is stale.'
          comment-issue-message: 'This issue has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within the next 7 days.'
          comment-pr-message: 'This pull request has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within the next 7 days.'
          only-if-changes-since-last-comment: true
```
